chunks.sanskrit: citiḥ svatantrā viśvasiddhihetuḥ | svecchayā svabhittau viśvam unmīlayati | tan nānā anurūpagrāhyagrāhakabhedāt | citisaṃkocātmā cetano 'pi saṃkucitaviśvamayaḥ | cittam
tanmayo māyāpramātā | saptapañcakasvabhāvaḥ | tadbhūmikāḥ sarvadarśanasthitayaḥ | cidvat tac chaktisaṃkocāt malāvṛtaḥ saṃsārī | tathāpi tadvat pañcakṛtyāni karoti
tāni | saṃsāritvam | cetanapadādhyārohāt citiḥ | meyendhanaṃ pluṣyati | balalābhe viśvam ātmasātkaroti
cidaikātmyapratipattidārḍhyaṃ jīvanmuktiḥ | madhyavikāsāc cidānandalābhaḥ | iha upāyāḥ | cidaikyāmarśān nityoditasamādhilābhaḥ | bhavatīti śivam
